:::{#sol-matrix-transpose-practice}

$\matr{B}$ is $3 \times 2$,
so its [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose) is $2 \times 3$.
The $i$th [row of $\tp{\matr{B}}$](#def-matrix-row) is the $i$th [column of $\matr{B}$](#def-matrix-column):

$$
\tp{\matr{B}} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 4 \\ -2 & 3 & 5 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

For instance, entry $(2, 3)$ of $\tp{\matr{B}}$ is $b_{32} = 5$.

:::
